candidates.change_summary: Change the required msg.value from 10 ether to 1 ether (single-statement replacement).
Change the require that timestamp increases to require it is at least as large (>=) instead of strictly greater (>).
Assign pastBlockTime to block.number instead of block.timestamp (single-statement replacement).
Change the conditional so transfer happens when block.number % 15 != 0 (invert condition).
Delete the require that msg.value equals 10 ether, allowing other values and thereby changing observable behavior.
Insert an additional transfer to sender unconditionally after updating pastBlockTime (single-statement insertion).
Move the update of pastBlockTime to occur after the conditional transfer (single-statement move).
